result.reason: The redline adds affiliates, contractors, and M&A-successor transfers, but omits the required perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences and the uncured-material-breach termination limitation for subscription licences. It also grants the successor-assignment exception to both parties, unnecessarily expanding TrueLink’s assignment rights rather than addressing only transfer of the Client’s licence. The licence wording is also slightly ambiguous because “its business” does not clearly address use by affiliates and contractors. The margin comment overstates compliance with the playbook.
